series.title: AI War（AI Ecosystem War）
series.description: 一份關於 AI 產業食物鏈、資本永動機、開發者生態裂變，以及兩大帝國靜悄悄決戰的深度分析報告 本研究共分為八個主題，每個主題為獨立的深度分析文章： 想快速掌握全局： 先讀主題 01（食物鏈）和主題 04（緊箍咒），這兩篇呈現了微軟困境的全貌。

docs.title: 微軟與蘋果的 AI 生態暗戰：全景式產業研究
docs.description: 一份關於 AI 產業食物鏈、資本永動機、開發者生態裂變，以及兩大帝國靜悄悄決戰的深度分析報告 本研究共分為八個主題，每個主題為獨立的深度分析文章： 想快速掌握全局： 先讀主題 01（食物鏈）和主題 04（緊箍咒），這兩篇呈現了微軟困境的全貌。

docs.title: 主題一：AI 食物鏈的階級遊戲——誰是地主，誰是租客？
docs.description: AI 產業的競爭不是「誰的模型更聰明」，而是誰掌握了結構性的成本優勢與分發管道。理解這個「食物鏈」的階級邏輯，是看懂後續所有主題的基礎。 OpenAI 在 2025 年砍掉了旗下最具話題性的 AI 影片生成產品 Sora，同期年度虧損飆升，Disney 10 億美元合作告吹。

docs.title: 主題二：微軟與 OpenAI 的危險雙人舞——互相綁架、世紀陽謀、與脫身計劃
docs.description: 微軟與 OpenAI 的關係是科技史上最複雜、最畸形的商業聯姻。表面上是戰略合作，實際上是一場互相綁架的危險博弈——雙方都在明處攜手、暗處脫身。 很多人簡單地把微軟歸類為「OpenAI 的投資者」或「OpenAI 的盟友」。這是極度簡化的理解。

docs.title: 主題三：AI 永動機——千億美元的資金循環
docs.description: AI 產業正在運行一台精巧的「資金永動機」：投資者把錢投給 AI 公司，AI 公司立刻把錢花在買晶片和雲端上，錢又流回投資者的口袋——每個環節都產生「營收」，但真正從終端用戶口袋掏出來的新錢有多少？這是 2000 年網際泡沫以來最值得警惕的金融結構。

docs.title: 主題四：微軟的四道緊箍咒——被鎖死的 AI 帝國
docs.description: 表面上，微軟是 AI 狂潮的最大贏家。但翻開底牌，微軟正被四道「緊箍咒」死死勒住，處境可能比完全沒有雲端算力的 Apple 更加嚴峻。 過去兩年，微軟的 AI 戰略可以用一個詞概括：「鋪入口」。

docs.title: 主題五：開發者生態的兩面夾擊——Claude Code 與 Google 的聯合瓦解
docs.description: 這是原系列完全遺漏、但在 2025-2026 年對微軟衝擊最大的一個維度。

docs.title: 主題六：Apple 的靜悄悄反殺——不只是晶片
docs.description: Apple 一直被嘲笑「AI 發展太慢」。但如果你看懂了結構性優勢的邏輯，就會發現 Apple 正在進行一場教科書級別的降維打擊——它不跟微軟搶雲端，卻在硬體底層、隱私架構、和消費端體驗三個維度同時構築了護城河。Apple 的 AI 策略不是「落後」，而是「不同戰場」。

docs.title: 主題七：AI 影視的路線之爭——2D 生成 vs 3D 世界模擬
docs.description: Sora 的退場不代表 AI 影視已死——而是宣告了：靠暴力算力「憑空生成」影片的商業模式，在沒有低成本算力和分發平台的前提下走不通。 AI 影視的未來取決於技術路線選擇、成本結構、和分發管道三者的組合。

docs.title: 主題八：Xbox 的豪賭與危機——AI 試驗場的戰略價值 vs 商業化風險
docs.description: Xbox 是微軟所有業務線中唯一一個完全擺脫了 Windows 歷史包袱、實現了軟硬體閉環的生態系統。從戰略圖紙來看，它是微軟 AI 版圖中最前衛的資產。但「有潛力」和「能成功」之間隔著一片隨時會翻船的汪洋大海。

docs.title: 微軟與蘋果的 AI 生態暗戰：全景式產業研究
docs.description: 一份關於 AI 產業食物鏈、資本永動機、開發者生態裂變，以及兩大帝國靜悄悄決戰的深度分析報告 本研究共分為八個主題，每個主題為獨立的深度分析文章： 想快速掌握全局： 先讀主題 01（食物鏈）和主題 04（緊箍咒），這兩篇呈現了微軟困境的全貌。

docs.title: 主題一：AI 食物鏈的階級遊戲——誰是地主，誰是租客？
docs.description: AI 產業的競爭不是「誰的模型更聰明」，而是誰掌握了結構性的成本優勢與分發管道。理解這個「食物鏈」的階級邏輯，是看懂後續所有主題的基礎。 OpenAI 在 2025 年砍掉了旗下最具話題性的 AI 影片生成產品 Sora，同期年度虧損飆升，Disney 10 億美元合作告吹。

docs.title: 主題二：微軟與 OpenAI 的危險雙人舞——互相綁架、世紀陽謀、與脱身計劃
docs.description: 微軟與 OpenAI 的關係是科技史上最複雜、最畸形的商業聯姻。表面上是戰略合作，實際上是一場互相綁架的危險博弈——雙方都在明處攜手、暗處脱身。 很多人簡單地把微軟歸類為「OpenAI 的投資者」或「OpenAI 的盟友」。這是極度簡化的理解。

docs.title: 主題三：AI 永動機——千億美元的資金循環
docs.description: AI 產業正在運行一台精巧的「資金永動機」：投資者把錢投給 AI 公司，AI 公司立刻把錢花在買晶片和雲端上，錢又流回投資者的口袋——每個環節都產生「營收」，但真正從終端用户口袋掏出來的新錢有多少？這是 2000 年網際泡沫以來最值得警惕的金融結構。

docs.title: 主題四：微軟的四道緊箍咒——被鎖死的 AI 帝國
docs.description: 表面上，微軟是 AI 狂潮的最大贏家。但翻開底牌，微軟正被四道「緊箍咒」死死勒住，處境可能比完全沒有雲端算力的 Apple 更加嚴峻。 過去兩年，微軟的 AI 戰略可以用一個詞概括：「鋪入口」。

docs.title: 主題五：開發者生態的兩面夾擊——Claude Code 與 Google 的聯合瓦解
docs.description: 這是原系列完全遺漏、但在 2025-2026 年對微軟衝擊最大的一個維度。

docs.title: 主題六：Apple 的靜悄悄反殺——不只是晶片
docs.description: Apple 一直被嘲笑「AI 發展太慢」。但如果你看懂了結構性優勢的邏輯，就會發現 Apple 正在進行一場教科書級別的降維打擊——它不跟微軟搶雲端，卻在硬體底層、隱私架構、和消費端體驗三個維度同時構築了護城河。Apple 的 AI 策略不是「落後」，而是「不同戰場」。

docs.title: 主題七：AI 影視的路線之爭——2D 生成 vs 3D 世界模擬
docs.description: Sora 的退場不代表 AI 影視已死——而是宣告了：靠暴力算力「憑空生成」影片的商業模式，在沒有低成本算力和分發平台的前提下走不通。 AI 影視的未來取決於技術路線選擇、成本結構、和分發管道三者的組合。

docs.title: 主題八：Xbox 的豪賭與危機——AI 試驗場的戰略價值 vs 商業化風險
docs.description: Xbox 是微軟所有業務線中唯一一個完全擺脱了 Windows 歷史包袱、實現了軟硬體閉環的生態系統。從戰略圖紙來看，它是微軟 AI 版圖中最前衞的資產。但「有潛力」和「能成功」之間隔着一片隨時會翻船的汪洋大海。

docs.description: When you think it's a platform glitch or the algorithm not promoting you, the truth may be that you've already been silently blocked from the field. An exclusion mechanism that requires luck to uncover is the perfect silencing.

docs.title: Half an Hour on the Assembly Line — When Content Farms Don't Need an Enemy to Win an Information War
docs.description: Half an hour, three accounts, the same article — a complete industrial chain from AI production to AI consumption, winning an information war without needing an enemy.

docs.title: The Least AI-Like Article Was Actually Written by AI — A Real-Time Experiment in Cognitive Blind Spots
docs.description: The detector is built on the failure modes of imitators — so the one who most resembles the original is punished most severely.

docs.title: One Like, One Point; One Flame War, Thirty Points — After the Forums Disappeared, Complexity Lost Its Place
docs.description: What truly disappeared was not any particular stance, but the space that could accommodate complexity.

series.title: Exit Mechanism Trilogy
series.description: Three essays sharing one sentence: When price signals are suppressed, actors that should exit fail to do so. From distortions in global supply, to land rent intercepting the dividend of cheapness, to the mutual lock-in of capital and labor.

docs.title: Exit Mechanism Trilogy: The Cost of Cheapness
docs.description: Three essays sharing one sentence: When price signals are suppressed, actors that should exit fail to do so. From distortions in global supply, to land rent intercepting the dividend of cheapness, to the mutual lock-in of capital and labor.

docs.id: TechNotes/你的定期存款，補貼了德國人買車
docs.title: Your Fixed Deposits Subsidized German Car Buyers
docs.description: China's over-accumulation and America's financialization are not two distinct illnesses — they are two organs of a single system. For the past twenty years, both regimes have been postponing each other's day of reckoning.

docs.id: TechNotes/四個地方，沒有一個人拿到那筆便宜
docs.title: Four Places Where No One Captured the Cheapness
docs.description: The cheapest goods in history are produced right next door, yet in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, inland China, and Taiwan, no one captured that cheapness. Where did it go?

docs.title: Capital Won't Leave, People Won't Leave
docs.description: The true health metric of an economy is not its growth rate, but its exit rate. Today, capital and labor have simultaneously lost the ability to leave.

series.title: Snatching Rice from the Beggar's Bowl
series.description: Money keeps flowing to the top, the share left below shrinks year after year, and everyone else is steered into fighting the people beside them. Four essays, one pie cut thinner every year.

docs.title: Prologue: Snatching Rice from the Beggar's Bowl
docs.description: Money keeps flowing to the top, the share left below shrinks year after year, and everyone else is steered into fighting the people beside them. Four essays, one pie cut thinner every year.

docs.title: Suffer If You Don't Work? From CSSA to UBI, Whose Principle Is “More Work, More Pay”?
docs.description: The premise that people who don't work should live worse comes from England's 1834 Poor Law, and its function has always been to hold down wages. A society needing work done does not mean people must work to deserve to live; the height of the safety net sets the floor for every level.

docs.title: Global Top, Local Bottom
docs.description: An office administrator on HK$22,000 a month ranks in the global top quarter, yet after rent she cannot afford a phone. Guilt and fear steer attention downward; those who take most of the pie are never part of the comparison.

docs.title: The Fraud You Can See, the Numbers Nobody Measures
docs.description: Public housing worked in Hong Kong for decades and now seems to have failed for no stated reason. Means tests see payslips but not cash or offshore assets, so those screened out are the ones who declare honestly. Welfare fraud is an enforcement problem, not a problem with protection itself.

docs.title: Those Who Leave and Those Who Arrive
docs.description: Hong Kong's statistics department publishes only net figures; one-way permit holders and talent-scheme arrivals count as “local” after seven years, and where they came from disappears. Asking for data is not discrimination: it is not that it cannot be measured, but that no one measures it.

docs.title: Final Part: After the Counting
docs.description: Taiwan already counts clearly, yet wages stagnate and homes remain out of reach. The middle class are both victims and beneficiaries, and land prices are chained to public finance, the tax base and capital: any single policy is pulled back by the whole chain.

series.title: Legal Right to Harm

docs.id: Diary/合法的不公平與不合法的欺瞞——樂風集團案中兩種「欺詐」的分界線
docs.title: Lawful Unfairness and Unlawful Deception — The Dividing Line Between Two Kinds of 'Fraud' in the Lofter Group Case
docs.description: Using standard startup financing as a control group, this article dissects the dividing line between PE contracts' lawful suppression and Lofter's information asymmetry toward investors, along with what everyone in business must know about PG risk.

docs.id: Diary/一場豪賭的正常與不正常
docs.title: Postscript: The Normal and the Abnormal in a High-Stakes Gamble
docs.description: Re-examining the Lofter Group case through the lens of 'you bet, you lose': the gamble was normal, the PG was normal, the high leverage was normal — the only thing that was not normal was who got pushed onto the gambling table.

docs.title: Seven-Day Book: Body, Mind, and Spirit
docs.description: Seven days of writing, from the 'no sympathy' years of corporate consulting, a farm under the Milky Way, a blank check from the Akashic Records, to a year of quiet standstill and the readjustment of presbyopic eyes. A candid introspection piercing the veneer of spirituality to confront an unorganized inner space.
